description: A v3 device binding (SPEC §3.2, §3.3, §3.4): the statement bytes, the Nostr key derived from the device secret, the BIP-322 binding signature, and the kind-30078 event id. The address and key are BIP-322’s own published test vector key (P2WPKH, mainnet); never use them for anything real.
